title: Feedback:Game updates/20260107
wikitext:
==Update -- January 7, 2026==

* Fixed an issue where the [[title]] badges for [[Dhuum's Covenant]] and [[Reforged Mode]] were sometimes missing (or applied too early, before the first title rank was earned).
* Fixed a bug where getting [[drunk]] (in game!) caused an internal rendering buffer to clobber the visible graphics rendering buffer.
* Fixed a long-standing bug where [[Wintersday]]s maps would  s l o w  down the longer they ran (this is why you might have seen a message that a [[district]] was unavailable).
* Fixed a bug where some players used a different random number generator than others, resulting in desyncs.
* Fixed a bug where a player's [[territory]] wasn't always reported to the game server correctly.
* Moved the location of inaccessible [[Charr Champion]]s for the [[Vanguard Annihilation: Charr]] [[quest]] when in Reforged mode.
* Adjusted the max reverb delay when using OpenAL Soft to reduce the intensity of droning sounds in some areas.
* Closed some previously open gates along [[Great Northern Wall|The Great Northern Wall]] in [[the Northlands]]; fortunately, [[the Charr]] were not exploiting these.
Hotfix:
* Fixed a bug where the [[User interface#Effects monitor|skill monitor]] was right-justified instead of left-justified.
